description: Structured eval definitions for the Kinesis Data Analytics Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across application creation (Flink, SQL, Zeppelin runtime), source configuration (Kinesis Data Stream), destination configuration (Kinesis Data Stream), checkpointing, parallelism and KPU tuning, CloudWatch logging, application snapshots, Studio notebooks with Zeppelin, session window SQL patterns, and prerequisite failure branches (missing execution role, missing source stream). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Production Flink streaming application with checkpointing, parallelism, snapshots
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — full checklist with execution role, checkpointing, parallelism, source, destination
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a production Kinesis Data Analytics Flink application named "fraud-detection-flink" in us-east-1. Runtime environment FLINK-1_19. Service execution role KDAExecutionRole with Kinesis GetRecords/GetShardIterator on stream transactions, Kinesis PutRecord/PutRecords on stream alerts, S3 GetObject on s3://kda-apps/fraud-detection-1.0.0.jar, CloudWatch Logs on /aws/kinesis-analytics/fraud-detection-flink. Source: Kinesis Data Stream transactions (4 shards, ACTIVE), starting position LATEST. Destination: Kinesis Data Stream alerts. Checkpointing: interval 60000 ms, min pause 5000 ms. Parallelism: 4, parallelismPerKPU 1. Application snapshots enabled. Auto-scaling off. CloudWatch log group /aws/kinesis-analytics/fraud-detection-flink. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APPLICATION: fraud-detection-flink
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Runtime environment — FLINK-1_19, application mode STREAMING
  [✓]      Service execution role — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/KDAExecutionRole (Kinesis read, Kinesis write, S3 code, CloudWatch Logs)
  [✓]      Source — Kinesis Data Stream arn:aws:kinesis:us-east-1:123456789012:stream/transactions, starting position LATEST
  [✓]      Destination — Kinesis Data Stream arn:aws:kinesis:us-east-1:123456789012:stream/alerts
  [✓]      Application code — s3://kda-apps/fraud-detection-1.0.0.jar (pinned version)
  [✓]      Checkpointing — interval 60000 ms, min pause 5000 ms, configuration CUSTOM
  [✓]      Parallelism — 4 (parallelismPerKPU 1, 5 KPUs total)
  [✓]      CloudWatch logging — enabled, log group /aws/kinesis-analytics/fraud-detection-flink
  [✓]      Application snapshots — enabled for stateful recovery
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production, Application=fraud-detection
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws kinesisanalyticsv2 describe-application --application-name fraud-detection-flink
  aws iam get-role --role-name KDAExecutionRole
  aws kinesis describe-stream --stream-name transactions
  aws logs describe-log-groups --log-group-name-prefix /aws/kinesis-analytics/fraud-detection-flink

eval_cases.name: Production SQL application with session window analytics
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — SQL runtime, session windows, Kinesis source and destination
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a production Kinesis Data Analytics SQL application named "session-windows-sql" in us-east-1. Runtime environment SQL-1_0. Service execution role KDAExecutionRole with Kinesis GetRecords on stream clicks, Kinesis PutRecord on stream sessions-out, CloudWatch Logs on /aws/kinesis-analytics/session-windows-sql. Source: Kinesis Data Stream clicks (ACTIVE), JSON record format, columns event_time (TIMESTAMP), user_id (VARCHAR(64)), event_type (VARCHAR(32)). Starting position NOW. Destination: Kinesis Data Stream sessions-out. Application code: session window pump using SESSION(event_time, INTERVAL '60' SECONDS) grouping by user_id with COUNT(*) aggregate. CloudWatch log group /aws/kinesis-analytics/session-windows-sql. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APPLICATION: session-windows-sql
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Runtime environment — SQL-1_0
  [✓]      Service execution role — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/KDAExecutionRole (Kinesis read, Kinesis write, CloudWatch Logs)
  [✓]      Source — Kinesis Data Stream arn:aws:kinesis:us-east-1:123456789012:stream/clicks, starting position NOW
  [✓]      Destination — Kinesis Data Stream arn:aws:kinesis:us-east-1:123456789012:stream/sessions-out
  [✓]      Application code — inline SQL with SESSION(event_time, INTERVAL '60' SECONDS) session window
  [✓]      CloudWatch logging — enabled, log group /aws/kinesis-analytics/session-windows-sql
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production, Application=session-windows
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws kinesisanalyticsv2 describe-application --application-name session-windows-sql
  aws iam get-role --role-name KDAExecutionRole
  aws kinesis describe-stream --stream-name clicks
  aws logs describe-log-groups --log-group-name-prefix /aws/kinesis-analytics/session-windows-sql

eval_cases.name: Flink application with no service execution role provided
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — execution role required for runtime AWS API calls
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a Kinesis Data Analytics Flink application named "report-flink-prod" in us-east-1. Runtime environment FLINK-1_19. Service execution role: NONE PROVIDED (the operator forgot to create the IAM role). Source: Kinesis Data Stream events (ACTIVE). Destination: Kinesis Data Stream report-out. Checkpointing: interval 60000 ms. Parallelism: 2. Application code s3://kda-apps/report-1.0.0.jar. CloudWatch log group /aws/kinesis-analytics/report-flink-prod. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APPLICATION: report-flink-prod
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗]      Service execution role — REQUIRED but NONE PROVIDED. The execution role is assumed by the KDA application for all runtime AWS API calls (Kinesis reads, Kinesis writes, S3 code retrieval, CloudWatch logging). Without it, the application fails with AccessDeniedException on the first Kinesis GetRecords call. Create a role trusting kinesisanalytics.amazonaws.com with scoped Kinesis/S3/CloudWatch permissions.
  [✓]      Runtime environment — FLINK-1_19
  [✓]      Source — Kinesis Data Stream events (ACTIVE)
  [✓]      Destination — Kinesis Data Stream report-out
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws iam get-role --role-name KDAExecutionRole
  aws kinesisanalyticsv2 describe-application --application-name report-flink-prod

eval_cases.name: Flink application referencing a non-existent source stream
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — source stream required for the application to read records
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a Kinesis Data Analytics Flink application named "etl-flink-prod" in us-east-1. Runtime environment FLINK-1_19. Service execution role KDAExecutionRole with Kinesis GetRecords on stream ingestion-events, S3 GetObject on s3://kda-apps/etl-1.0.0.jar, CloudWatch Logs. Source: Kinesis Data Stream ingestion-events — DOES NOT EXIST (the operator referenced a stream name that was never created; describe-stream returns ResourceNotFoundException). Destination: Kinesis Data Stream etl-out. Checkpointing: interval 60000 ms. Parallelism: 4. Application code s3://kda-apps/etl-1.0.0.jar. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APPLICATION: etl-flink-prod
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Runtime environment — FLINK-1_19
  [✓]      Service execution role — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/KDAExecutionRole (Kinesis read, S3 code, CloudWatch Logs)
  [✗]      Source — Kinesis Data Stream ingestion-events DOES NOT EXIST (describe-stream returns ResourceNotFoundException). The source stream MUST exist and be ACTIVE before the application can read records. Create the stream or correct the stream name.
  [✓]      Destination — Kinesis Data Stream etl-out
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws kinesis describe-stream --stream-name ingestion-events
  aws kinesisanalyticsv2 describe-application --application-name etl-flink-prod
